avocado.lore.epic: Squashed itself into guacamole in the shopping bag, and the whole lift at the shopping centre went green.
avocado.lore.legendary: Was perfectly ripe for exactly five minutes, so the whole family flew home from holiday to eat it in time.

broccoli.lore.rare: Hides inside the mashed potato and jumps out on the very last forkful.
broccoli.lore.legendary: Grew so big on the allotment that a family of squirrels moved in, thinking it was a real tree.

carrot.lore.epic: Was pulled up by a rabbit so strong that the whole row came up after it like a string of sausages.
carrot.lore.legendary: Grew so long underground that it came out on the other side of the world, and a farmer there keeps watering it.

cherries.lore.rare: Comes in pairs, and if you eat one, the other follows you round the kitchen until you eat it too.
cherries.lore.epic: Spat a stone so hard at the summer fair that it rang the bell on the strongman game.
cherries.lore.legendary: Sat on top of a cake so tall that it had its own weather, and came down wearing a tiny snow cap.

coconut.lore.epic: Took a whole beach party, two spades and a lifeguard to open, and then it was empty.
coconut.lore.legendary: Floated across the whole ocean to a beach that already had far too many coconuts, so it went home again.

corn.lore.rare: Hears everything through its ears, so the whole field knows the farmer's secrets by lunchtime.
corn.lore.epic: Grew so tall that the maze cut through its field swallowed a school trip until teatime.
corn.lore.legendary: Popped enough popcorn in one go to fill the cinema, so the film had to be shown on the outside wall.

cucumber.lore.rare: Disguises itself as a courgette whenever someone wants a salad, and as a cucumber whenever they want soup.
cucumber.lore.epic: Grew so many in one greenhouse that the door burst open and they rolled down the lane like logs.
cucumber.lore.legendary: Stayed so cool on the hottest day of the year that the whole town queued to stand in its shade.

eggplant.lore.rare: Changes its name depending on who is talking, so the family argue about aubergine or eggplant all through dinner.
eggplant.lore.epic: Gleamed so purple at the market that a magpie stole it and flew it home with great difficulty.
eggplant.lore.legendary: Grew so big and shiny that the town used it as a mirror, and everyone looked slightly purple for a week.

grapes.lore.rare: Grows two new grapes every time one is eaten, so the bunch never gets any smaller.
grapes.lore.epic: Was trodden in a barrel at the harvest party, and the guests' feet stayed purple until spring.
grapes.lore.legendary: Grew a bunch so long that it hung from the hilltop vineyard all the way down into the village square.

lemon.lore.epic: Was squeezed so hard on pancake day that the juice hit the ceiling, and the kitchen pulled a sour face for a week.
lemon.lore.legendary: Was so sour that the whole lemonade stand puckered shut, and the street could only whistle until teatime.

melon.lore.rare: Grows a smiley face on its rind overnight, so nobody has the heart to cut it.
melon.lore.epic: Rolled off the market stall, across the car park and onto the bus, which took it home.
melon.lore.legendary: Was knocked on so often to check if it was ripe that it learned to knock back. It now answers the front door.

onion.lore.epic: Made the whole cinema cry during a comedy, and the film won a prize for best sad film.
onion.lore.legendary: Peeled itself for a whole week, layer by layer, and right at the end there was a tiny, very proud pearl onion.

orange.lore.rare: Has one more segment than it should, and it is always the one that squirts you in the eye.
orange.lore.epic: Rolled out of the half-time bag onto the pitch and scored the winning goal.
orange.lore.legendary: Was peeled in one spiral so long that it reached across town and was cut as the ribbon to open the new bridge.

palm_tree.lore.rare: Fans its big leaves so hard on a hot day that the beach towels blow into the sea.
palm_tree.lore.epic: Bent right over in a storm and flicked every coconut onto the lifeguard hut roof like a drum solo.
palm_tree.lore.legendary: Grew so tall on a tiny island that ships use it as a lighthouse, and it has started winking at them.

peach.lore.rare: Ripens at the very moment its owner leaves for a week's holiday, every single time.
peach.lore.epic: Was so juicy that one bite flooded the picnic blanket, and the ants arrived in tiny boats.
peach.lore.legendary: Grew so sweet that the bees gave up making honey and simply came to visit it.

pear.lore.rare: Makes anything near it go pear-shaped, so the birthday cake slid sideways before the candles were lit.
pear.lore.epic: Dropped onto the car roof just as the alarm was set, and the whole street woke up at midnight.
pear.lore.legendary: Fell from the tallest tree and bounced all the way to the farmers' market, where it sold itself.

pepper.lore.rare: Hides one hot pepper in every bag of sweet ones, and it always ends up on Grandad's plate.
pepper.lore.epic: Was stuffed with so much rice that it burst in the oven and decorated the ceiling.
pepper.lore.legendary: Grew so many colours at once that a rainbow came down to check it was not a relative.

pineapple.lore.rare: Wears its leaves like a crown, and every other fruit in the bowl now bows whenever it is picked up.
pineapple.lore.epic: Rolled off the party table and spiked every balloon in the room on its way to the door.
pineapple.lore.legendary: Was crowned so convincingly that the fruit bowl held a coronation, and the bananas still carry its train.

potato.lore.rare: Grows eyes that really look around, so the cupboard always knows who has been stealing the crisps.
potato.lore.epic: Sprouted so wildly in the cupboard that it pushed the door open and walked out into the garden.
potato.lore.legendary: Mashed itself so smoothly that the town used it to fill every pothole in the road.

pumpkin.lore.rare: Grins a little wider every night after it is carved, until it is grinning at the neighbours across the road.
pumpkin.lore.epic: Rolled off the doorstep on a windy night and bowled down the street, knocking over every bin like skittles.
pumpkin.lore.legendary: Grew so big that the family hollowed it out and moved in. The postman now delivers to the stalk.

strawberry.lore.epic: Got squashed under the picnic blanket so thoroughly that the blanket is now pink and smells of summer.
strawberry.lore.legendary: Made one jar of jam so good that every slice of toast in town jumped out of the toaster to meet it.

tomato.lore.uncommon: Hides behind its leaves until it is perfectly red, then shows off to every passer-by.
tomato.lore.legendary: Settled the fruit-or-vegetable argument for good by growing a banana. Nobody has dared mention it since.

tree.lore.rare: Shifts its roots in the night, so the garden path is a little lumpier every morning.
tree.lore.epic: Shook so hard in a storm that every conker in the park fell at once, and the squirrels declared a holiday.
tree.lore.legendary: Grew so old and so wise that the village owls bring it their problems, and it always tells them to wait and see.

watermelon.lore.rare: Gets heavier every time someone tries to carry it, so it always ends up being rolled home.
watermelon.lore.epic: Rolled off the beach table and was used as the ball for a whole game of beach football without cracking.
watermelon.lore.legendary: Grew so big that the town cut a door in it and used it as the summer paddling pool.

x_apple_tree.lore.uncommon: Drops its apples one at a time all night long, so the lawn goes thud until morning.
x_apple_tree.lore.rare: Hides its best apple behind a leaf at the very top, and moves it every time the ladder comes out.
x_apple_tree.lore.epic: Dropped an apple into the paddling pool, and the children's apple-bobbing game lasted until bedtime.
x_apple_tree.lore.legendary: Kept the doctor away so well that the village surgery closed and the doctor took up gardening.

x_apricot_fruit.lore.rare: Dries itself into a chewy little cushion whenever it is left in the sun, then refuses to be a fruit again.
x_apricot_fruit.lore.epic: Ripened so fast in a heatwave that the whole tree turned into jam before anyone could pick it.
x_apricot_fruit.lore.legendary: Glowed so orange at dusk that the sun went down early, thinking someone else had taken over.

x_asparagus.lore.rare: Grows so straight that the builders next door borrow it as a spirit level.
x_asparagus.lore.epic: Was served in a tall bundle at a posh dinner and toppled over every plate like a game of pick-up sticks.
x_asparagus.lore.legendary: Grew one spear so tall that the town hung its flag on it, and the flag is now slightly green.

x_bamboo_grove.lore.rare: Hides a whole path inside it and moves the path a little every night, so hikers come out somewhere new.
x_bamboo_grove.lore.epic: Grew so tall overnight that it lifted the picnic table into the air with the picnic still on it.
x_bamboo_grove.lore.legendary: Grew a stem so tall that the Moon got stuck on it for a night, and the town had to shake it loose.

x_banana_tree.lore.rare: Swats anyone who tries to pick a bunch before it is ready with one of its giant leaves.
x_banana_tree.lore.epic: Grew a bunch so heavy that the tree bent right over and offered it to the people at the bus stop.
x_banana_tree.lore.legendary: Grew a leaf so huge that a whole village sheltered under it in the monsoon, and the rain sounded like applause.

x_baobab.lore.rare: Flips over at night, so the birds wake up perched on its roots and the roots wake up in the sky.
x_baobab.lore.epic: Held so much water in a drought that the elephants queued at it like a drinking fountain.
x_baobab.lore.legendary: Grew so wide that the town opened a post office inside its trunk, and the queue goes round the outside.

x_basil.lore.rare: Makes every room it is in smell of pizza, so everyone keeps checking the oven.
x_basil.lore.epic: Grew so bushy in the window box that the pigeons nested in it and came out smelling of pasta.
x_basil.lore.legendary: Made a pesto so good that the spaghetti started twirling itself onto the forks.

x_beet.lore.epic: Rolled off the table at school dinner and left a pink trail all the way to the head teacher's office.
x_beet.lore.legendary: Dyed the river pink for a whole summer, and the swans refused to come out until it was white again.

x_birch_tree.lore.epic: Peeled so much papery bark in a gale that the whole school did its homework on it.
x_birch_tree.lore.legendary: Was so white that the snow mistook it for a friend and stayed on it until July.

x_blackberry.lore.epic: Grew over the parked car so fast that its owner had to pick his way to the door and came out with purple hands.
x_blackberry.lore.legendary: Grew so fast that it swallowed a whole lane, and the delivery van came out the other side a week later, full of jam.

x_blueberry.lore.rare: Turns anyone's tongue blue, so nobody can ever lie about eating the last muffin.
x_blueberry.lore.epic: Burst in the washing machine and dyed the whole family's school shirts blue for a term.
x_blueberry.lore.legendary: Gave a whole school blue tongues on picture day, and the photos still hang in the hall.

x_bok_choy.lore.rare: Bounces out of the wok every time it is tossed and lands on the cook's head.
x_bok_choy.lore.epic: Sizzled so loudly at the street market that the drummers in the parade lost the beat.
x_bok_choy.lore.legendary: Was tossed so high in the wok that it came down in the next town's soup.

x_branch.lore.rare: Moves an inch every night, so the treehouse door never lines up with the ladder.
x_branch.lore.epic: Fell in a storm and landed exactly across two garden fences, so the neighbours now share a bench.
x_branch.lore.legendary: Was a dog's fetch stick for so long that the dog learned to throw it back.

x_brussels_sprout.lore.rare: Rolls itself onto the plate of whoever said they hated it, every single time.
x_brussels_sprout.lore.legendary: Rolled off the holiday table, out of the door and down to the shop, where it put itself back on the shelf.

x_bush.lore.common: Scratches the side of the car every time it parks in the drive.
x_bush.lore.legendary: Grew so round that the wind rolled it down the hill like a tumbleweed, and it is now a roundabout.

x_cassava.lore.rare: Insists on being cooked properly before anyone eats it, and sends back every plate that is not.
x_cassava.lore.epic: Grew roots so long that they came up in the neighbour's garden, and both families claimed it.
x_cassava.lore.legendary: Grew so much underground that the whole field rose up, and the farmer's house now has a sea view.

x_cedar.lore.rare: Smells so strongly of pencils that everyone near it starts doing their homework.
x_cedar.lore.epic: Was turned into a chest so moth-proof that the moths of the town held a protest outside it.
x_cedar.lore.legendary: Grew so wide on the mountain that the clouds have to walk round it.

x_celery.lore.rare: Has so many strings that the music teacher tuned it and played a lullaby on it.
x_celery.lore.epic: Crunched so loudly at the school concert that the orchestra lost its place and played the song backwards.
x_celery.lore.legendary: Grew a stalk so tall that the giraffe at the zoo stopped eating leaves and asked for celery.

x_chard.lore.legendary: Grew stalks in so many colours that the paint shop came to copy them and sold out of every one.

x_cherry_tree.lore.common: Hangs its cherries just out of reach of the shortest person in the house.
x_cherry_tree.lore.rare: Spits cherry stones at anyone who climbs it without asking first.
x_cherry_tree.lore.epic: Dropped so many cherries on the school roof that the gutters ran pink at home time.
x_cherry_tree.lore.legendary: Grew its cherries so high that a hot-air balloon came to pick them, and the pilot came back with a red mouth.

x_chili.lore.rare: Hides in the mildest dish on the table, so the curry is safe and the salad is not.
x_chili.lore.epic: Was so hot that the chef's moustache curled up and the kitchen smoke alarm went off on its own.
x_chili.lore.legendary: Was so hot that a dragon came all the way down the mountain to ask it for cooking tips.

x_christmas_tree_decorated.lore.rare: Switches its lights to flashing the moment anyone sits down to watch a film.
x_christmas_tree_decorated.lore.epic: Was decorated so heavily that it slowly tipped over and gift-wrapped the cat.
x_christmas_tree_decorated.lore.legendary: Wore so many fairy lights that the town's power went out, so it lit the whole street by itself.

x_coconut_tree.lore.rare: Walks a few steps along the beach when the tide comes in, so the sunbathers keep losing their spot.
x_coconut_tree.lore.epic: Bent so far in a storm that it catapulted its coconuts to the next island, which threw them back.
x_coconut_tree.lore.legendary: Grew so tall that its coconuts take a whole day to land, so it drops tomorrow's ones today.

x_cranberry.lore.rare: Floats to the top of anything: the bath, the soup and the agenda of every meeting.
x_cranberry.lore.epic: Rolled out of the sauce jar at the holiday dinner and bounced round the table into Grandad's glass.
x_cranberry.lore.legendary: Bounced so high off the kitchen floor that it landed on the Moon, and the Moon has been slightly pink ever since.
x_cranberry.lore.common: Is so sour that the whole fruit bowl puckers, and the apples have moved to the other side.

x_currant.lore.rare: Gets mistaken for a raisin by everyone, and has started correcting them in a very small voice.
x_currant.lore.epic: Was packed into a bun so tightly that the bun was mostly currants, and it bounced when it was dropped.
x_currant.lore.legendary: Was so tiny that it rolled into the gap between two seconds, and the town clock has been one second slow ever since.

x_cypress.lore.rare: Grows so tall and thin that it turns up in every holiday photo, exactly behind someone's head.
x_cypress.lore.epic: Blocked the wind so well that the kite festival behind it had to be called off for lack of breeze.
x_cypress.lore.legendary: Grew so tall and pointed that it popped a passing cloud, and the village got a quick shower.

x_date.lore.rare: Makes anything it is added to taste like pudding, even the soup.
x_date.lore.epic: Glued itself to a camel's knee at the market, and the camel walked funny all the way home.
x_date.lore.legendary: Was so sticky that it glued two sand dunes together, and the desert wind still cannot pull them apart.

x_dead_tree.lore.rare: Has no leaves of its own, so every autumn it borrows other trees' leaves and wears them for a day.
x_dead_tree.lore.epic: Fell over so slowly that the whole town had time to come and watch, and to bring sandwiches.
x_dead_tree.lore.legendary: Became home to so many owls, beetles and bats that it now has a waiting list.

x_dill.lore.rare: Turns any jar it is put in into a pickle jar, so the jam now tastes of gherkin.
x_dill.lore.epic: Got into the birthday cake by mistake, and the guests are still deciding whether it was a pickle.
x_dill.lore.legendary: Made one gherkin so famous that it now has its own fan club and a tiny hat.

x_dragon_fruit.lore.rare: Breathes out a little puff of pink mist when it is sliced, so everyone checks the kettle.
x_dragon_fruit.lore.epic: Was sliced open at the picnic, and its black seeds looked so like ants that everyone moved indoors.
x_dragon_fruit.lore.legendary: Hatched. Nobody is quite sure what came out, but the garden shed has been very warm ever since.

x_driftwood.lore.epic: Washed up in such a heap that the town built a pier from it, and the pier keeps trying to float home.
x_driftwood.lore.legendary: Has washed up on every beach in the world and has a sticker from each one.

x_durian.lore.legendary: Was opened on top of a mountain, and the clouds moved to the next valley.

x_edamame.lore.rare: Fires its beans straight into open mouths across the table, but only the mouth of whoever is talking.
x_edamame.lore.epic: Popped so many beans at the sushi bar that the conveyor belt carried them round for an hour.
x_edamame.lore.legendary: Popped every bean in the pod at once like fireworks, and the town cancelled its own display.

x_fig_fruit.lore.rare: Hides its flowers inside itself and will not tell anyone where they are.
x_fig_fruit.lore.epic: Dropped so many ripe figs on the patio that the sandals stuck to the ground and had to be left there.
x_fig_fruit.lore.legendary: Ripened on such a hot wall that it dried into a fig roll right there on the branch.

x_fir_tree.lore.rare: Holds snow on its branches until someone walks underneath, then lets go.
x_fir_tree.lore.epic: Grew so thick that the deer use it as a bus shelter in the rain, the whole herd at once.
x_fir_tree.lore.legendary: Grew so tall that its top is always in winter, even in July. Its bottom branches wear sunglasses.

x_firewood.lore.rare: Refuses to light until everyone gives up, then roars the moment they open the window to let the smoke out.
x_firewood.lore.epic: Stacked itself so neatly in the night that the woodpile is now taller than the cottage.
x_firewood.lore.legendary: Was so heavy that it took the whole family to carry it in, and it now lives in the living room as a bench.

x_ginger.lore.rare: Makes everyone who eats it say 'ooh' at the same moment, so a quiet dinner sounds like fireworks night.
x_ginger.lore.epic: Was grated into the gingerbread so generously that the gingerbread men jumped off the tray and ran out of the door.
x_ginger.lore.legendary: Spiced a single biscuit so strongly that it kept a whole snowy village warm for a week.

x_ginger_root.lore.rare: Points its knobbly fingers at whoever left it in the fridge, every time they open the door.
x_ginger_root.lore.legendary: Grew such long knobbly fingers that it learned to knit, and made the whole vegetable box scarves.

x_gooseberry.lore.rare: Is the odd one out at every picnic, and sits right between the couple on the blanket.
x_gooseberry.lore.epic: Was so sour that one bite made the whole village choir pull faces in the middle of a song.

x_green_bean.lore.common: Hangs in such a tangle that the one you want is always behind two others.
x_green_bean.lore.epic: Grew so many beans that the allotment shed filled up and the gardener had to climb out of the window.
x_green_bean.lore.legendary: Climbed so high that it reached the castle in the clouds, and came back down with a goose.

x_guava.lore.rare: Smells so sweet that it lures every fruit fly in town into the kitchen, then pretends it was not calling.
x_guava.lore.epic: Was cut open at breakfast, and it was so pink inside that the whole table gasped and the cat fell off its chair.
x_guava.lore.legendary: Ripened with such a sweet smell that passing ships turned round, thinking the island was having a party.

x_hedge.lore.rare: Grows a little taller every time the neighbours wave, until nobody can see each other.
x_hedge.lore.legendary: Was trimmed into a castle so well that a family of foxes moved in and put up a tiny flag.

x_herbs.lore.rare: Swaps the labels on its pots in the night, so the mint is the parsley and the soup tastes of toothpaste.
x_herbs.lore.epic: Grew so bushy on the windowsill that the kitchen window disappeared, and the house smells like a garden centre.
x_herbs.lore.legendary: Flavoured the air so strongly that every dinner in the street tasted wonderful, even the burnt ones.

x_horseradish.lore.epic: Was grated so strong that the whole table sneezed at once, and the gravy boat sailed off the end.
x_horseradish.lore.legendary: Cleared one blocked nose so hard that the sneeze blew the fog off the whole town.

x_jalapeno.lore.rare: Changes how hot it is depending on who is watching: mild for the cook and fiery for the guest.
x_jalapeno.lore.epic: Was sliced onto the sleepover pizza, and every child's ears glowed so red that nobody needed a torch.

x_kale.lore.rare: Crunches up in the oven and then refuses ever to be called a vegetable again.
x_kale.lore.epic: Was blended into a smoothie so thick that the blender gave up and went for a lie down.
x_kale.lore.legendary: Grew so curly in the cold that the hairdresser next door copied it, and now half the town has kale hair.

x_kiwi.lore.rare: Stares at whoever is about to eat it with its seedy green eye, until they put the spoon down.
x_kiwi.lore.epic: Rolled out of the fruit bowl so fuzzy that the dog brought it back like a tennis ball.
x_kiwi.lore.legendary: Was mistaken for a kiwi bird by a whole flock of kiwi birds, and is now their leader.

x_kumquat.lore.epic: Rolled off the party table into the punch bowl and bobbed there all night, turning the punch sour.
x_kumquat.lore.legendary: Was so sour in the middle that whoever ate it whistled for a week, and the dogs never left them alone.

x_leek.lore.rare: Grows a little bigger every time the gardener next door walks past, just to annoy him.
x_leek.lore.epic: Grew so big that the gardener rode it home from the allotment like a horse.

x_lemon_tree.lore.rare: Drops a lemon into every glass of water left near it, so nobody ever gets a plain drink.
x_lemon_tree.lore.epic: Dropped so many lemons in the heatwave that the garden pond turned into lemonade and the frogs got hiccups.
x_lemon_tree.lore.legendary: Gave life so many lemons that life gave up and made lemonade.

x_log_pile.lore.epic: Was taken apart for the fire, and so many creatures came out that the family put it all back.
x_log_pile.lore.legendary: Housed so many hedgehogs that they formed a marching band and parade round the garden at midnight.

x_lychee.lore.epic: Shot its stone across the restaurant into the waiter's top pocket, and he took it home as a souvenir.
x_lychee.lore.legendary: Was threaded onto a pearl necklace by mistake and went to a grand ball before anyone noticed.

x_mango.lore.uncommon: Never shows when it is ripe, so everyone stands in the shop squeezing it like an accordion.
x_mango.lore.rare: Turns into a hedgehog when it is cut, then curls up on the plate and refuses to be eaten.
x_mango.lore.epic: Dripped so much juice on the hot pavement that it became a sticky trap for every flip-flop in the street.
x_mango.lore.legendary: Was cut into a hedgehog the size of a sofa, and the real hedgehogs came from miles around to pay their respects.

x_maple_tree.lore.rare: Turns its sap into syrup inside the trunk, so every woodpecker in the wood gets sweet hiccups.
x_maple_tree.lore.epic: Was tapped so eagerly that the syrup came out like a fountain, and the pancake breakfast floated away.
x_maple_tree.lore.legendary: Made so much syrup in one spring that the river ran sweet, and the fish now stick together.

x_mint_leaves.lore.rare: Freshens the breath of anyone who walks past, so nobody in the house can tell who ate the garlic.
x_mint_leaves.lore.epic: Was dropped into the lemonade at the fair, and the whole tent got so fresh that everyone's teeth squeaked.
x_mint_leaves.lore.legendary: Freshened the air so well that the town rubbish tip smelled of toothpaste all summer.

x_nectarine_fruit.lore.uncommon: Shines so smoothly in the fruit bowl that the peaches have started feeling hairy.
x_nectarine_fruit.lore.epic: Rolled into the paddling pool and floated there so smugly that the rubber ducks moved out.
x_nectarine_fruit.lore.legendary: Was so smooth that the fruit bowl used it as a mirror, and the bananas now check their spots in it.

x_oak_tree.lore.rare: Drops acorns only on the squirrels who forgot where they buried the last ones.
x_oak_tree.lore.legendary: Grew one acorn so big that the squirrels had to roll it home together, and they are still eating it.

x_okra.lore.rare: Goes slimy at the exact moment someone says it is not slimy.
x_okra.lore.epic: Thickened the festival gumbo so much that it had to be served in slices.
x_okra.lore.legendary: Grew so many slippery pods that the slugs of the county came to it for lessons.

x_olive.lore.rare: Tastes like a grape to everyone who is expecting a grape, and that is the trouble.
x_olive.lore.epic: Rolled down the restaurant steps, and the waiter chased it all the way to the harbour.
x_olive.lore.legendary: Was pressed into oil so smooth that the town's squeaky gate has not squeaked since.

x_olive_tree.lore.rare: Flashes its silver leaves in the sun to dazzle the pickers, so half the olives are never found.
x_olive_tree.lore.epic: Twisted its trunk so hard in a storm that it turned to face the sea, and refuses to turn back.
x_olive_tree.lore.legendary: Is so old that it remembers when the hill was flat, and keeps reminding the hill.

x_orange_tree.lore.rare: Rolls an orange down the drive towards whoever is having a bad day.
x_orange_tree.lore.epic: Dropped so many oranges on the hill that the street below became an orange river, and the postman floated home.
x_orange_tree.lore.legendary: Gave so much juice that the town fountain was switched to orange, and the pigeons have never been healthier.

x_papaya.lore.rare: Softens any meat it touches, so the barbecue sausages fell apart before they reached the plate.
x_papaya.lore.epic: Fell from its tree onto the beach volleyball game, and the match became a fruit salad.
x_papaya.lore.legendary: Ripened so perfectly that the sunrise waited for it, and the morning started ten minutes late.

x_parsley.lore.epic: Was sprinkled on the wedding cake by a confused chef, and the guests are still picking green bits out of their teeth.

x_parsnip.lore.rare: Pretends to be a carrot in the dark, so the snowman ends up with a pale nose.
x_parsnip.lore.epic: Roasted so sweetly that the whole dinner was eaten before anyone remembered the gravy.
x_parsnip.lore.legendary: Got so sweet in the frost that the snowmen in the field queued up to swap their carrots for it.

x_passion_fruit.lore.rare: Turns any pudding tropical, so the school custard now has a suntan.
x_passion_fruit.lore.epic: Was dropped into the yoghurt factory, and every pot in the country came out crunchy for a week.
x_passion_fruit.lore.legendary: Wrinkled into such perfect ripeness that the town's grandads asked for its secret. It said 'more sitting down'.

x_pea_pod.lore.rare: Zips itself shut again whenever someone tries to open it, like a stubborn purse.
x_pea_pod.lore.epic: Popped open in the school canteen and sent peas bouncing into every child's custard.
x_pea_pod.lore.legendary: Grew a pea so big that a princess slept on it, forty mattresses up, and still did not get a wink.

x_persimmon.lore.rare: Holds on to its branch all winter and refuses to fall until everyone has stopped looking.
x_persimmon.lore.epic: Dropped all at once in the first frost and bounced down the street like orange tennis balls.
x_persimmon.lore.legendary: Hung on so long that the tree grew new leaves round it, and even the tree cannot say which year it belongs to.

x_pine.lore.rare: Whispers in the wind so convincingly that hikers turn round to answer it.
x_pine.lore.epic: Scented the whole forest so strongly that every walker came out smelling like a brand-new car.
x_pine.lore.legendary: Grew so high up the mountain that it holds the summit flag, and the climbers have to ask its permission.

x_plum_fruit.lore.rare: Hides its ripe plums behind the hard ones, so every picker gets the hard ones.
x_plum_fruit.lore.epic: Dropped so many plums on the parked car that it drove away looking like a purple leopard.
x_plum_fruit.lore.legendary: Dried so slowly in the sun that it became a prune, then changed its mind and became a plum again.

x_pomelo.lore.epic: Rolled off the market stall, was mistaken for a bowling ball and knocked down every skittle in the alley.
x_pomelo.lore.legendary: Has a peel so thick that a family of mice lives in it and has never met the fruit inside.

x_prune.lore.rare: Wrinkles everything it is kept next to, so the raisins look younger beside it.
x_prune.lore.epic: Soaked overnight in the breakfast bowl and swelled up so much that it lifted the lid off the cereal box.
x_prune.lore.legendary: Was so wrinkly that a map maker traced its creases and drew a whole new mountain range.

x_quince.lore.rare: Perfumes the whole cupboard so strongly that the biscuits now taste of quince.
x_quince.lore.epic: Was so hard to cut that the cook borrowed the woodcutter's axe, and the kitchen table split in two.
x_quince.lore.legendary: Cooked down into a jelly so firm that the town used it to fix the wobbly bridge.

x_radish.lore.epic: Grew so fast in the school garden that the class had to harvest it in the middle of maths.
x_radish.lore.legendary: Was so peppery that one slice cleared the whole class's colds, and the school nurse went on holiday.

x_raisin.lore.rare: Pretends to be a chocolate chip in every cookie, and disappoints everyone.
x_raisin.lore.epic: Fell out of a lunchbox into the school radiator and slowly turned back into a grape.
x_raisin.lore.legendary: Told the young grapes such stories about lying in the sun that they all asked to be dried.

x_redwood.lore.rare: Drinks so much fog that the town below it never has a misty morning, and the photographers are furious.
x_redwood.lore.epic: Dropped a cone from the very top, and it took so long to land that the walkers had a picnic while they waited.
x_redwood.lore.legendary: Grew so tall that it has its own weather at the top, and the squirrels up there wear woolly hats.

x_rosemary.lore.rare: Is said to help the memory, so it remembers every single time someone forgot to water it.
x_rosemary.lore.epic: Grew so bushy over the path that the postman came out of it smelling like Sunday lunch.
x_rosemary.lore.legendary: Remembered so much that it reminded the whole town of every birthday, and nobody has missed one since.

x_salad_bowl.lore.rare: Hides all the croutons at the bottom, so whoever serves last gets every one.
x_salad_bowl.lore.epic: Was tossed so eagerly at the barbecue that the lettuce landed on the neighbour's hedge.

x_shrub.lore.rare: Grows back in the shape of whoever last trimmed it, so the garden now has a bush that looks like Grandad.
x_shrub.lore.epic: Grew so fast round the bird bath that the birds now have to book a table.
x_shrub.lore.legendary: Grew so wide and so round that the garden is now a shrub with a small house in the middle.

x_spinach.lore.rare: Gives a little burst of strength to whoever eats it, so every jam jar in the house is now open.
x_spinach.lore.epic: Was eaten by the school tug-of-war team, and they pulled the other team, the rope and the goalposts across the field.
x_spinach.lore.legendary: Gave a tortoise so much energy that it won the town fun run, and it still has not stopped.

x_spring_onion.lore.rare: Makes everyone's breath so strong that the dentist works with the window open.
x_spring_onion.lore.epic: Was chopped so finely at the noodle bar that a breeze blew it into every bowl in the street.
x_spring_onion.lore.legendary: Grew so many stalks at once that the noodle bar used it as a broom, and the floor now smells delicious.

x_sprouts.lore.rare: Wriggles its little tails in the jar, so everyone checks that it is not full of worms.
x_sprouts.lore.legendary: Sprouted so fast in a forgotten lunchbox that it grew a tiny garden, complete with a tiny fence.

x_spruce.lore.uncommon: Smells so strongly of the winter holidays that people start wrapping presents in June.
x_spruce.lore.rare: Hums when it is tapped, so the woodpeckers keep stopping to listen and never finish a hole.
x_spruce.lore.legendary: Was made into a violin that played so well that the forest it came from swayed in time.

x_star_fruit.lore.rare: Catches the light so well that its slices twinkle on the plate, and the moths circle the dinner table.
x_star_fruit.lore.epic: Was sliced into stars for the school play, and the cast had to eat the sky before the second act.
x_star_fruit.lore.legendary: Was mistaken for a real star by a lost ship, which followed it all the way to the fruit market.

x_taro.lore.rare: Grows leaves so big and waterproof that the frogs use them as umbrellas and will not give them back.
x_taro.lore.epic: Turned a whole cafe's bubble tea purple, and the customers' tongues matched the cafe sign for a week.
x_taro.lore.legendary: Was so knobbly and hairy that the school mistook it for the class hamster and sent it home for the holidays.

x_thyme.lore.rare: Makes time pass slower in the kitchen, so the soup takes ages and the cook is always late.
x_thyme.lore.epic: Was stirred into the stew so late that the stew had already been eaten yesterday.
x_thyme.lore.legendary: Had so much thyme on its hands that it stopped the town clock and let everyone have a lie-in.

x_tofu.lore.rare: Tastes of whatever is next to it, so the fruit salad ended up tasting of garlic.
x_tofu.lore.epic: Wobbled so much on the plate that the table, the chairs and the guests started wobbling too.
x_tofu.lore.legendary: Wobbled so hard that it set off the town's earthquake alarm, and the jelly factory got the blame.

x_topiary.lore.rare: Changes its animal shape overnight, so the peacock is a rabbit by morning.
x_topiary.lore.epic: Was trimmed into a lion so convincing that the postman would not come through the gate.
x_topiary.lore.legendary: Was trimmed into an elephant so lifelike that it walked off to the zoo and asked to be let in.

x_tree_stump.lore.rare: Pretends to be a stool, then grows a mushroom exactly where you were going to sit.
x_tree_stump.lore.legendary: Grew back into a whole tree overnight after being chopped down, and the woodcutter said sorry.

x_turnip.lore.rare: Rolls under the kitchen table whenever anyone mentions soup.
x_turnip.lore.legendary: Grew so big that the family, the dog, the cat and a mouse all had to pull it up, and the mouse took the credit.

x_twig.lore.common: Snaps loudly under your foot at exactly the moment you are trying to sneak up on someone.
x_twig.lore.rare: Turns into a wand in any child's hand, but only does tiny spells, like untying shoelaces.
x_twig.lore.epic: Fell into the stream, raced the paper boats all the way to the sea, and won.
x_twig.lore.legendary: Was waved so hard by one child that the rain stopped, and the school sports day went ahead after all.

x_willow_tree.lore.rare: Weeps onto anyone who sits underneath it, then says it was only the dew.
x_willow_tree.lore.epic: Dipped its branches into the river and fished out every lost football in the town.
x_willow_tree.lore.legendary: Wept so much in one summer that the river rose, and the whole town went to work by boat.

x_yam.lore.rare: Pretends to be a sweet potato at the shop, and nobody can prove otherwise.
x_yam.lore.epic: Was so heavy that the harvest cart tipped over and the yam rolled to the front of the parade.
x_yam.lore.legendary: Was roasted so sweetly that the pudding trolley sent it a note saying it had gone too far.

x_yuzu.lore.epic: Floated in the bath so happily that it refused to get out, and the family had to shower for a week.
x_yuzu.lore.legendary: Scented the steam from one bath so strongly that the whole street had a warm, lemony fog for a day.
